warnings: Warnings Do not use this product ■ Do not use this product if you are hypersensitive or allergic to any of its ingredients. When using this product ■ Use this product only for brushing teeth. Stop use and ask a physician, dentist, or pharmacist if Bring the product information with you whenever possible when seeking medical advice. ■ Irritation develops after using this product. ■ Swelling of the mouth or face occurs. Do not transfer it to another container, as doing so may result in accidental misuse or reduce the quality of the product.
